title: Artificial Intelligence with CBC based Morphometric Parameters aimed toward effective diagnostic practices for Dysplasia associated Hematological Malignancies
summary: Machine-learning classification of CBC morphometric and cell-population features distinguished dysplasia-associated hematologic malignancy groups in a retrospective clinical sample. The result is limited to the study’s patient groups and does not establish prospective diagnostic performance.
ai_technology: Machine-learning classifiers assess dysplasia-associated hematologic malignancy from CBC morphometric features.
organization: National Institute of Blood Diseases and Bone Marrow Transplantation

evidence.tested: CBC morphometric and cell-population measurements were evaluated with machine-learning classifiers for dysplasia-associated hematologic malignancy groups.
evidence.unknown: The evidence is retrospective and limited to the reported patient groups; prospective workflow validation was not shown.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning classifiers assess dysplasia-associated hematologic malignancy from CBC morphometric features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
